video_file.id as f_id, video_file.name as f_name,video_file.file_url as f_file_url,video_file.save_type as f_save_type, video_file.video_long as f_video_long ,video_file.file_type_index as f_file_type_index,video_file.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url,video_file.thumb_nail_id as thumb_nail_id,video_file.file_type as f_file_type ,video_file.upload_uid

course_avatar.id AS course_avatar_file_id, course_avatar.name AS course_avatar_file_name, course_avatar.file_url AS course_avatar_file_url, course_avatar.save_type AS course_avatar_file_save_type, course_avatar.file_type AS course_avatar_file_type

course_owner.id AS course_user_id, course_owner_info.id AS course_user_info_id, course_owner_info.first_name AS course_user_info_first_name, course_owner_info.last_name AS course_user_info_last_name, course_owner_avatar.id AS course_user_info_avatar_file_id, course_owner_avatar.file_url AS course_user_info_avatar_file_url, course_owner_avatar.save_type AS course_user_info_avatar_file_save_type, course_owner_avatar.file_type AS course_user_info_avatar_filetype
mapper.select:
SELECT course_content.id, course_content.course_id, course_content.content_id, course_content.order, , , course_owner.id AS user_id, (SELECT COUNT(id) FROM gc_video_comment WHERE video_id = video.id) AS comment_num, , ,
FROM course_content JOIN gc_video video ON course_content.content_id = video.id JOIN sys_file video_file ON video.file_id = video_file.id
JOIN gc_subject course ON video.origin_course_id = course.id JOIN gc_user course_owner ON course.create_user = course_owner.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_avatar ON course_avatar.id = course.sub_img_id LEFT JOIN gc_user_info course_owner_info ON course_owner.info_id = course_owner_info.id LEFT JOIN sys_file course_owner_avatar ON course_owner_info.avatar_file_id = course_owner_avatar.id WHERE course_content.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY course_content.order
